Commentary.Commentary: Out come the players for the second half! Litton Das and Tanzid Hasan are the openers. Fazalhaq Farooqi to begin.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now the target is a small one and Bangladesh should be chasing this down! Afghanistan on the other hand, will have to bowl really well if they are to defend this. Wickets is what they need, they have the bowlers but the wicket is not offering a lot. Can they turn it around? We will find out. Join us for the chase in a bit.

To be honest, Bangladesh were not at their best with the ball. Especially with the new nut, their bowlers were quite wayward and leaked far too many runs earlier on. However, Shakib turned things around. The skipper stepped up when his side needed it and as the game went on, the others started to contribute too. Mehidy Hasan was excellent and gave able support to Shakib Al Hasan! The pacers also got into the game later on and overall, Shakib will be very pleased with his boys.

What a collapse that was! At one stage, Afghanistan looked all set for 300 at least. After being inserted, their top order was excellent. Rahmanullah Gurbaz especially and the top three laid the platform for a decent total but once Rahmat Shah fell. The scoring rate went down and Afghanistan succumbed under pressure. They kept losing wickets at regular intervals and just never recovered. From 112 for 2, they have been bowled out for 156. A really poor show from the middle and the lower order and that has put Afghanistan right onto the back foot.

OUT! TAKEN! There is the end of the innings! Shoriful Islam gets his second. A short one on middle, Naveen-ul-Haq looks to pull, it goes off the top edge towards deep square leg. Towhid Hridoy runs in and takes it. AFGHANISTAN BOWLED OUT FOR 156!

Commentary.Commentary: OUT! TAKEN! That is a really smart catch! Bangladesh have two in quick succession and this is the big fish, it is the well-set Rahmanullah Gurbaz who falls three short of a half ton. The pressure has got to him too. He was deprived of strike in the recent overs and things had gone quiet too. However, not sure if he needed to go after the Fizz, especially with Hashmatullah Shahidi being dismissed in the last over. This though is wonderfully bowled, excellent deception. Sees Gurbaz come down the track and bowls a lovely slower one outside off. Gurbaz is through his shot early. It goes more off the outer half towards deep cover. Tanzid Hasan runs in and takes a neat catch.

Commentary.Commentary: Time for the action to begin! The players make their way out to the middle. The openers for Afghanistan are Ibrahim Zadran and Rahmanullah Gurbaz! Taskin Ahmed to begin. Here we go...
Time for the National Anthems! First it is Afghanistan who will sing theirs and then it will be Bangladesh.

Rashid Khan is up for an interview. He says it is a big moment. They are a famous side in India. Reckons the conditions will be different in the World Cup. Adds they need to be consistent and adapt to the conditions as it is a longer format. Mentions the more they play, the better they will get.

Afghanistan (PLAYING XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Ibrahim Zadran, Rahmat Shah, Hashmatullah Shahidi (C), Mohammad Nabi, Najibullah Zadran, Azmatullah Omarzai, Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Naveen-ul-Haq, Fazalhaq Farooqi.

Bangladesh (PLAYING XI) - Tanzid Hasan, Litton Das, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mahedi Hasan, Shakib Al Hasan (C), Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Towhid Hridoy, Mahmudullah, Taskin Ahmed, Shoriful Islam, Mustafizur Rahman.

Hashmatullah Shahidi says they are well prepared for this tournament and he feels they will do well here. Adds they need to bat well and give the spinners enough runs to defend. Reckons the boys playing in the Indian T20 League is a advantage as they will have an idea about the conditions.

Shakib Al Hasan says they want to field! There will be something in the wicket and that is what will suit their side. Adds he is very pleased to lead his side and he hopes they have a good game. Mentions they want to enjoy this tournament and he hopes the youngsters can do well.
